mapper.insert: insert into drive_upload_operation (operation_id,actor_id,space_id,parent_id,file_name,size_bytes,sha256,status,owner,create_time,update_time) values (#{operationId},#{actorId},#{spaceId},#{parentId},#{fileName},#{sizeBytes},#{sha256},'PROCESSING',#{owner},now(3),now(3)) on duplicate key update operation_id=operation_id
mapper.select: select * from drive_upload_operation where operation_id=#{operationId} for update
mapper.update: update drive_upload_operation set status='PROCESSING',owner=#{owner},update_time=now(3) where operation_id=#{operationId} and status='FAILED_SAFE'
update drive_upload_operation set status=#{status},node_id=#{nodeId},update_time=now(3) where operation_id=#{operationId} and owner=#{owner} and status=#{expected}
